title: Track guide Oulton Park - Island Historic Ray FF1600 Open iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake to 60 at left banner, trail off
corners.mistakes: hit hill inside, right tires off track

corners.label: T3
corners.mistakes: brake too much, rear will slide; avoid incident point on outside

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: quick touch on the brake to about 40
corners.line: aim for a little part of a curb on the inside
corners.exit: full throttle once the car gets grip again
corners.mistakes: overdo this corner and you will end up in the wall

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: break to about 60 and then a trail to break all the way to the first curve

corners.line: Apex late on the first curb, middle on the second

corners.label: T9
corners.line: Use all of the outside curb
corners.mistakes: Use all of the curve on the outside, hit the grass and you'll spin

corners.spoken_as: penultimate tree before the Marshall's post

general_tips: Use all of the outside curb on the left going up to turn nine for overtaking
